# Flames

> *Note: Do not confuse Flames with the flame trail produced by [Fire Ants](/wiki/Fire_Ant).*

**Flames** are objects generated by certain [tools](/wiki/Tools), [ability tokens](/wiki/Ability_Tokens), or [passive abilities](/wiki/Passive_Abilities). They have a percentage chance to spawn when certain bees gather pollen, lasting for 4 seconds.

While active, flames collect pollen from surrounding flowers and deal damage:
*   **Pollen Collection:** Each second, they collect 5 red, 3 white, or 2 blue [pollen](/wiki/Pollen) from 9 surrounding flowers. This collection rate increases by +2% per red bee and +4% per gifted red bee (if spawned by the player), and +10% per bee level (if spawned by a bee).
*   **Damage:** They deal 10 + (25% of [base Bee Attack](/wiki/Bee_Attack)) damage per second to any mob (dealing 15 damage if spawned by the player).
*   **Buffs:** Flames grant the player [flame heat](/wiki/Buffs_%26_Debuffs#From_Passives).

Flames can be generated by:
*   The [Scythe](/wiki/Scythe)
*   [Fire Bee](/wiki/Fire_Bee), [Demon Bee](/wiki/Demon_Bee), or [Spicy Bee's](/wiki/Spicy_Bee)
*   [Inferno](/wiki/Ability_Tokens#Inferno) ability tokens
*   Bees equipped with the ![Bead Lizard](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)[Bead Lizard](/wiki/Bead_Lizard) or ![Electric Candle](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)[Electric Candle](/wiki/Electric_Candle) beequips
*   The [Fire Mask](/wiki/Fire_Mask)'s Ignite passive
*   The [Demon Mask](/wiki/Demon_Mask)'s X-Flame passive

Flames are also used to help grow Scorching Stars.

## Flame Heat

**Flame Heat** grants extra Red Pollen and Bee Attack, starting at x1.2 [Red Pollen](/wiki/System_Page#Red_Pollen) and a +5% [Bee Attack](/wiki/Bee_Attack) Multiplier. The more flames around the player, the faster Flame Heat grows up to a maximum of 20 seconds, granting x2 Red Pollen and a +25% Bee Attack Multiplier.

Flame Heat boosts [Spicy Bee's](/wiki/Spicy_Bee) Movespeed and gather speed. It can also be consumed by [Precise Bee](/wiki/Precise_Bee) to convert Pollen into Honey.

## Gathering Flames

The **Gathering Flames** passive increases the chance for a bee to spawn a flame while gathering pollen from a field. The Gathering Flames+ upgrade further boosts this chance.

*   Fire Bees' base chance is 35% (50% if gifted).
*   Demon Bees' Gathering Flames+ base chance is 65% (85% if gifted).

This passive chance can be increased for individual bees by equipping the ![Bead Lizard](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)[Bead Lizard](/wiki/Bead_Lizard) or ![Electric Candle](data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIABAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAEALAAAAAABAAEAQAICTAEAOw%3D%3D)[Electric Candle](/wiki/Electric_Candle):
*   **Bead Lizard:** Increases Gathering Flames chance from +9% to +14%.
*   **Electric Candle:** Increases Gathering Flames chance from +1% to +5%. Using waxes can increase this amount up to +25% Gathering Flames chance.

## Dark Flames

Flames that are hit with [Dark Scythe](/wiki/Dark_Scythe) convert into **dark flames**. This dark violet version collects pollen from 13 surrounding flowers (instead of 9), deals 50% more damage, and grants both dark heat and normal flame heat. Dark flames also grant an additional 33% growth to Scorching Stars.

## Flame Stats

Several aspects of flames can be improved using stats and modifiers.

### Flame Pollen
**Flame Pollen** is the total amount of pollen that flames can collect, viewable on the system page.

Ways to increase Flame Pollen:
*   **Demon Mask:** Provides a x1.25 Flame Pollen multiplier.
*   **Gifted Fire Bee:** Provides a x1.25 Flame Pollen multiplier.
*   **Beequips:**
    *   **Electric Candle (Individual):** Grants +5% to +10% Flame Pollen. Using [waxes](/wiki/Waxes) can increase this up to 50%.
    *   **Electric Candle (Hive Bonus):** Grants +1% Flame Pollen as a hive bonus. Using waxes can increase this amount up to 11%.
*   **Cog Amulets:**
    *   Silver Cog Amulet: Up to +5% Flame Pollen.
    *   Gold Cog Amulet: Up to +8% Flame Pollen.
    *   Diamond Cog Amulet: From +12% up to +14% Flame Pollen.
    *   Supreme Cog Amulet: From +15% up to +20% Flame Pollen.
*   **Stickers:**
    *   Small Flame Bee Sticker: +3% Flame Pollen.
    *   Dark Flame Sticker: +3% Flame Pollen.
    *   Orange Swirled Marble Sticker: +3% Flame Pollen.
*   **Robo Bear Challenge (Epic Upgrades):**
    *   Furnace: Grants x1.5 Flame Pollen.

### Flame Duration
**Flame Duration** determines how long flames last. It can be increased by a gifted Spicy Bee bonus (+25% more time) or by the [Gifted](/wiki/Gifted_Bee) Spicy Bee's [Flame Fuel](/wiki/Ability_Tokens#Flame_Fuel) ability (+50% more time). Flame Fuel also causes the flames to instantly convert 50,000 pollen plus 10% (plus +5% per Field Boost) of the hive's total convert amount.

### Instant Flame Conversion
**Instant Flame Conversion** dictates how much collected pollen is immediately converted.

Ways to increase Instant Flame Conversion:
*   Fire Mask: Grants +50% Instant Flame Conversion.
*   Demon Mask: Grants +50% Instant Flame Conversion.
*   Scorching Star: Grants +50% Instant Flame Conversion.

### Other Improvements
Certain upgrades from the Robo Bear Challenge can modify flames:
*   **Furnace (Epic Upgrade):** Grants x1.5 Flame Duration and x1.5 Flame Damage.
*   **Invert (Epic Upgrade):** Makes flames collect 4x pollen from blue flowers.
